brief_rationale: The model systematically queried the workspace and used returned records across multiple turns to anchor the diagnosis (left lower lobe pulmonary sequestration), the DSA/intervention plan, and the pre-intervention workup. It screened for red-flag symptoms including hemoptysis, chest pain, dyspnea, and fever at multiple points, gave explicit emergency triggers, and obtained a teach-back in the final turn. All major responsibility-chain items were met without error. Three high-order points (HO1, HO3, HO4) were triggered and actively completed with evidence integrated into the plan, closure, and communication style; therefore the trajectory satisfies Strong (Grade 4). Since two high-order points are required for Perfect but HO2 was not completed, Grade 5 is not reached.
